metadata.name: vortex_vault
metadata.description: Vortexes prop-firm vault: a prop-firm DAO's pooled fund, whose shares are the DAO's own token. Deposits and redemptions are priced together at windows, at a value the program computes itself from Phoenix's accounts.

instructions.name: check_drawdown
docs: Anyone (the bot's keeper) can check the drawdown between windows:
below the limit, trading pauses until a proposal resumes it.

instructions.name: claim_fees
docs: Pays fee recipient `index` the fee shares owed to it. Anyone, into
the recipient's own account.

instructions.name: claim_redemption
docs: Your money from a processed epoch's redemption, as far as the vault
holds it idle (the rest once the desk has brought money back).
Anyone, into the owner's own account.

instructions.name: claim_shares
docs: Your shares from a processed epoch's deposit.

instructions.name: create_vault
docs: Opens a DAO's vault over `asset_mint`, with the DAO's token as its
shares. Signed by the share mint's authority, which must be the DAO's
creator (at a launch) or its treasury (a proposal); minting passes to
the vault here, so the token only ever comes from deposits. The token
has no supply yet and no freeze authority. `seeder` may seed it once
(a launch's raise); default: nobody.

accounts.name: creator
docs: The share mint's authority: the DAO's creator or its treasury.

instructions.name: execute
docs: Runs one instruction as the vault: moving money to or from Phoenix,
delegating a subaccount to a trader's key, and so on. The first
remaining account is the program to call, the rest its accounts (the
vault signs where it appears). Never the share mint or the escrow
(members' shares), never this program, and not in the run-up to a
window.

instructions.name: pause
docs: Pauses trading by proposal, e.g. ahead of a vote on the desk.

instructions.name: process_window
docs: Prices the open epoch's requests. Anyone, once the window is due and
nothing has moved for `settle_delay`. Remaining accounts: the venue
accounts in the vault's order (see `set_venues`).

accounts.name: allowed
docs: Needed when the vault isn't open to all: `[ALLOWED_SEED, vault, user]`.

instructions.name: request_redeem
docs: Hands `amount` shares to the vault, to redeem at the next window.

instructions.name: resume
docs: Resumes trading after a drawdown pause.

instructions.name: seed
docs: The money already in the vault becomes its first shares, sent to
`receiver` (the Distributor, which shares them among the raise's
contributors). Once, by the seeder, while there are no shares.

instructions.name: set_allowed
docs: Lets `who` deposit (or stops them) while the vault isn't open to all.

instructions.name: set_fee_splits
docs: Replaces who gets the fees, once every recipient has claimed theirs.

instructions.name: set_venues
docs: The venue accounts the vault is valued from: Phoenix's PerpAssetMap
and the vault's Phoenix trader accounts (cross and isolated
subaccounts), and other token accounts the vault owns that count 1:1
(e.g. Phoenix's collateral token). The DAO registers each before
moving money into it; a window must see all of them.

types.name: Allowed
docs: `[ALLOWED_SEED, vault, who]`.

fields.name: required
docs: How many signers must confirm.

fields.name: tenure
docs: Seconds after `seated_at` before the DAO can replace the signers
without their confirmation.

fields.name: nonce
docs: Goes up with every change, so approvals given to an earlier council
don't count.

fields.name: governance_program
docs: The governance program running the DAO now.

fields.name: governance
docs: The DAO's account in that program: `[GOVERNANCE_SEED, dao, epoch]` there.

fields.name: epoch
docs: Starts at 1 and goes up with every switch. Proposals only run in
the epoch they were made in.

fields.name: council
docs: The security council, when on.

fields.name: allowance_count
docs: How many allowances this DAO has granted (the latest id).

fields.name: owed
docs: Fee shares (in the escrow) not yet claimed.

fields.name: bps
docs: Of each fee; the splits add up to 10,000.

types.name: Vault
docs: `[VAULT_SEED, dao]`.

fields.name: share_mint
docs: The DAO's token; the vault is its only minter.

fields.name: assets
docs: Idle money: `[ASSETS_SEED, vault]`.

fields.name: escrow
docs: Shares waiting to be redeemed or claimed, and fee shares owed: `[ESCROW_SEED, vault]`.

fields.name: seeder
docs: May seed the vault once (a launch's raise); default: nobody.

fields.name: epoch
docs: The open epoch: requests made now are priced at its window.

fields.name: high_water
docs: The best share price after fees so far (asset units per share unit, times ONE).

fields.name: pending_deposit_assets
docs: In the open epoch.

fields.name: owed_assets
docs: Redemptions priced, not yet paid.

fields.name: initial_rate
docs: Share units per asset unit for the first deposit (one share per asset).

fields.name: interval
docs: Seconds between windows, e.g. 30 days.

fields.name: freeze_before
docs: No moves this long before a window.

fields.name: settle_delay
docs: A window waits this long after the last move.

fields.name: management_bps
docs: Per year, of the vault's value.

fields.name: performance_bps
docs: Of gains above the high water mark.

fields.name: max_drawdown_bps
docs: Below the high water mark that pauses trading; 0: off.

fields.name: open_to_all
docs: False: only addresses the DAO allowed may deposit.

fields.name: max_price_age_slots
docs: The oldest Phoenix mark price a valuation accepts, in slots.

types.name: VaultEpoch
docs: `[EPOCH_SEED, vault, epoch]`.

types.name: VaultRequest
docs: `[REQUEST_SEED, vault, epoch, owner]`.
